newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Land grants partner well interest.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Land grants partner well interest.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said Wednesday it will farm out its working interest in a Louisiana well to its partner after failing to find commercial quantities of hydrocarbons in the well.
LL&E said the deep saline well in Terrebonne Parish, Louisiana, was drilled to 21,780 feet without encountering commercial quantities of hydrocarbons.
LL&E, which had 60 percent working interest in the well, said it will farm out its interest to Texas Meridian Resources Corp, which owned a 27.5 percent working interest.
Texas Meridian will deepen the well to test additional sands, LL&E said.
LL&E said it will retain a 15 percent working interest in the well after payout in addition to about 20 percent royalty interest as fee land owner.
